about: A format sent to a model nested more than 5 levels deep (chapter 2 § 2.3.1), the root object being level 1. The agent node plan returns the package format nested_sections. Invalid: its deepest object is at level 6. Valid: at level 5, the limit.
sentences: Format 'nested_sections' nests 6 levels deep at /properties/a/properties/a/properties/a/properties/a/properties/a; a format sent to a model nests at most 5.
